rationale: Restore the proven 0.x four-pixel antenna status contract without changing any receiver or transmitter control path. Pixel 0 belongs to CC1101 and pixels 1..3 to nRF24 slots 1..3. The exact raw brightness ladder is 0/2/3/5/8/12 out of 255 with 2 as the first-install default and a legacy led_br migration. LEDs are updated only on state changes: green means that receiver is active, red means its receiver path faulted, and all pixels are cleared in Safe Mode.
required_host_checks: native exact brightness ladder, invalid-value fallback and CC/N1/N2/N3 bit mapping
EN/RU generated-font fit and five-row scrolling Settings contract
state-change-only physical adapter with no timing loop or animation
exact firmware build and unchanged RX-only safety contracts
required_hil_scenarios: one changed-candidate flash on original board-01 only
all six brightness settings cycle and the selected value survives reset
nRF24 receive reports exactly the LEDs belonging to detected active slots
CC1101 receive reports only its dedicated LED
external camera retains the nRF24 and CC1101 physical LED states when available
the requested stock 2/255 preference is restored across a final reset
zero radio TX, input drops, storage changes and final ownership
